name: Sunset Slush
description: Shaved ice downtown. The hot-afternoon answer on the W Main end.

name: Brevard Downtown Chocolates
description: Chocolates and scoops on W Main, a block from the trailhead.

name: The Yard
description: Playset, kids’ bike park, and ice cream at 284 Railroad Ave — the one stop that gets them riding.

name: Flower Hopscotch
description: A flower painted on the path with numbered petals to hop, near the McLean Rd crossing.

name: Robot Hopscotch
description: A robot-shaped hopscotch painted on the path, just past the Fisher Rd crossing by the rescue squad. A quick hop for little legs.

name: Rocky's Grill & Soda Shop
description: Soda fountain on Broad St. Milkshakes, floats, and a lunch counter.

name: Kilwins
description: Hand-paddled ice cream and fudge on W Main. Easy downtown stop.

name: White Squirrel Arcade
description: Italian ice at 40 N Caldwell St, with arcade games to go with it.

kids.description: Retro arcade at 40 N Caldwell St, for all ages, with Italian ice to go with it.

name: Dolly's Dairy Bar
description: The Pisgah classic, at the far end of the bridge connector. Mostly flat the whole way from town.

name: Silversteen Park
description: Neighborhood park on Hillview St, a couple of blocks off the West Main trailhead.

name: Brevard First United Methodist
description: Church playground open to the public after 12pm Monday through Friday.

kids.description: Church playground open to the public after 12pm on weekdays. The church's Weekday Children's Program preschool is here too.

name: Franklin Park
description: Neighborhood playground and shade just south of downtown.

name: Silvermont Mansion & Park
description: Big playground on the Silvermont lawn at 364 E Main, with a picnic pavilion and the mansion grounds to wander.

name: Jameson's Joy (Ninja Park)
description: Ninja-course fitness park at the Parks & Rec fields. Open 24 hours and fully accessible.

name: Broad Street Wines
description: Bottle shop and wine bar at 30 S Broad, right in the middle of town.

name: The Map Room at D.D. Bullwinkel’s
description: Beer and wine on draft at 60 E Main, plus events and film screenings.

name: Brevard Brewing Company
description: Lagers at 63 E Main, a block from the downtown link. Racks out front.

name: Noblebräu Brewing · 185 King Street
description: Brewery and listening room at 185 King St, a short block off the path, with live music several nights a week.

name: Griffon & Sphynx
description: Small taproom at 212 King St.

name: Oskar Blues (Tasty Weasel Taproom)
description: Taproom, food, and a big lawn at 342 Mountain Industrial Dr.

name: Ecusta Brewing Company
description: At 451 Ecusta Rd, a few steps off the path. Easy post-ride pint.

name: Earth Mountain
description: Closest shop to the downtown end. Service, parts, and local advice.

name: CykelWorx
description: Bike shop at 72 S Broad St, a block off Main downtown. Service, parts and repairs.

name: Sycamore Cycles
description: At 112 Hendersonville Hwy. From the light at the Ecusta bypass, cross the highway, turn left and follow the sidewalk and bike lane.

name: Squatch Bikes & Brews
description: Shop and taproom in one at 170 King St, on the King St row.

kids.name: Squatch Bikes
kids.description: Bike shop at 170 King St, on the King St row.

name: Weevil Outdoor
description: Mountain bike gloves, jerseys and accessories, made by Weevil, with beer on tap at 367 Hendersonville Hwy. From the path at Ecusta Rd, take the Ecusta bypass bike lane and cross at the light.

kids.description: Mountain bike gloves, jerseys and accessories, made by Weevil, at 367 Hendersonville Hwy. From the path at Ecusta Rd, take the Ecusta bypass bike lane and cross at the light.

name: The Hub & Pisgah Tavern
description: Shop and tavern at 11 Mama’s Pl, at the forest gateway a couple of hundred feet short of Dolly’s.

kids.name: The Hub
kids.description: Bike shop at 11 Mama’s Pl, at the forest gateway a couple of hundred feet short of Dolly’s.

name: Railroad Depot Repair Stand
description: At Jimmy Harris Railroad Depot Park — pump and tools, plus restrooms, parking, and the ballerina sculpture.

name: Library Repair Stand
description: Tools on cables and a floor pump outside the Transylvania County Library, at the end of the Jordan St route.

name: Mid-Path Fix-It Stand
description: Pump plus a chain tool, with a water bottle filler beside it.

name: Oskar Blues Repair Stand
description: Pump and tools by the bike racks at the taproom door, at the end of the spur.

kids.name: Mountain Industrial Repair Stand
kids.description: Pump and tools by the bike racks at the end of the spur, beside the CHUBwagon.

name: Pisgah Forest Repair Stand
description: Last stand before the bridge — the pump gauge actually works.

name: Sully's Steamers
description: Steamed sandwiches and hot dogs at 33 E Main St, a block from the courthouse. Quick, cheap and easy to share.

name: HomeSlyce on King
description: Pizza by the slice at 143 King St, almost directly across from Squatch.

name: Morning Social
description: Breakfast and coffee on King St, right next to Squatch.

name: CHUBwagon at Oskar Blues
description: The brewery's own food truck at 342 Mountain Industrial Dr: smash burgers, chicken tenders, grilled cheese, hot dogs and a kids' cheeseburger.

kids.name: CHUBwagon
kids.description: Food truck at 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, at the end of the spur: smash burgers, chicken tenders, grilled cheese, hot dogs and a kids' cheeseburger.

name: Gordingo's
description: Food at Ecusta, 451 Ecusta Rd, a few steps off the path at the north end.

name: Pisgah Bakehouse
description: Bakery at 1980 Asheville Hwy, up the short connector from the roundabout at the north end.

name: Pisgah Forest Elementary School
description: Public elementary school, pre-K to 5th grade, right beside the path in Pisgah Forest.

name: Brevard Elementary School
description: Public elementary school, pre-K to 5th grade, at 399 Greenville Hwy, by the sidewalk from Silvermont. Extending the path here is planned.

name: Brevard Middle School
description: Public middle school at 400 Fisher Rd. A short connector from the path at Fisher Rd reaches the school.

name: Brevard High School
description: Public high school at 609 N Country Club Rd, on the south side of town. Not on the path yet.

name: Pisgah Collective
description: Outdoor, nature-based early childhood program at 2753 Asheville Hwy, past the north end of the path.

name: Mountain Sun Community School
description: Small independent school using Montessori principles, from age 3 through middle school, at 299 Andante Ln.

name: Brevard Academy
description: Free public charter school, kindergarten to 8th grade, at 1110 Hendersonville Hwy.

name: Presbyterian Weekday Preschool
description: Church preschool at Brevard-Davidson River Presbyterian, 249 E Main St.

name: New Adventure Learning Center
description: Full-day child care and preschool run by Transylvania County at 260 S Gaston St.

name: Brevard College
description: Small liberal arts college beside downtown, One Brevard College Dr.

name: Blue Ridge Community College
description: The Transylvania campus at 45 Oak Park Dr, a short ride from the path.

name: Boys & Girls Club of Transylvania County
description: The Cindy Platt club at 11 Gallimore Rd: after-school and summer programs for ages 5 to 18, and a Teen Clubhouse next door.

name: Brevard Rock Gym
description: Bouldering gym at 240-B S Broad St. Open climb Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday evenings and Saturday afternoons, with day passes and rental shoes at the desk, plus youth climbing programs.

name: Transylvania Tae Kwon Do
description: Tae Kwon Do classes by belt level at 242 S Broad St, including a Tigers class for ages 4 to 6.

name: Carolina Dance Collective
description: Dance studio at 1266 Asheville Hwy, Suite 2: ballet, tap, jazz, modern, musical theater and hip-hop from age 5, and a Nutcracker every winter.

name: Brevard Health & Racquet Club
description: Membership club at 1325 N Country Club Rd with indoor and outdoor pools, swim lessons and a summer swim team.

name: O.P. Taylor's
description: The downtown toy store, at 16 S Broad St on the corner by the courthouse.

name: Transylvania County Library
description: The public library at 212 S Gaston St, with kids' programs and an outdoor StoryWalk.
hours: Mon & Thu 9:30–8pm · Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat 9:30–5:30pm

name: Franklin Park Pool
description: The town's outdoor public pool at 109 Lakeview Ave, inside Franklin Park.
